verdict.rationale:
Temporal ships official SDKs (TypeScript, Python, etc.) with dedicated AI-agent integration docs (OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude tool-calling cookbook) showing agentic loops built directly against the SDK primitives (Workflows/Activities) with durable retries and state survival. This directly supports building AI-native agent applications on official SDKs rather than community wrappers.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports specifically building AI agents with the SDK, and a complete list of all officially supported languages beyond TS/Python in the AI context.
